name: ArtSudoku
summary:
ArtSudoku brings the timeless appeal of Sudoku to VR in a whole new way!
Every Sudoku puzzle hides a famous masterpiece. As you solve the puzzle step by step, the artwork is gradually revealed piece by piece. Enjoy the satisfaction of solving Sudoku while watching iconic works of art come to life before your eyes.
